modelDescription: Industry's safest micro-rimfire shooters cock the rifle by lifting the bolt and unload without pulling the trigger. Builds superior shooting skills thanks to full-size rifle features, including adjustable peep sights and Savage's user-adjustable AccuTrigger. Safe, accurate, easy to use. Manual safety.
